data.one_liner: Localization and internationalization library for Flutter supporting JSON translations.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to define translations for app content in different languages using inline or nested JSON. It supports pluralization, RTL layouts, fallback locales, and automatic locale saving and restoration.
use_when: You need standard runtime localization using JSON files.
You require right-to-left (RTL) language support and fallback locales.
You want automatic saving and restoring of the selected user locale.
avoid_when: You prefer type-safe, code-generated localization alternatives.
You do not use JSON for managing your translation dictionaries.
strengths: Easy to use with simple global methods for translations.
Supports mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
weaknesses: Lacks compile-time safety or code generation for translation keys.
Documentation relies heavily on external wiki pages.
data.setup_notes: Configure translation files and initialize the localization delegate in your app startup.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Flutter's official internationalization framework.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer type-safe localization through code generation.

alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want another popular JSON-based runtime localization option.
